newsitem.title: USA: Uniphase to acquire IBM unit.
newsitem.headline: Uniphase to acquire IBM unit.

text.p: Uniphase Corp Monday said it signed a definitive agreement to acquire the assets of the IBM Laser Enterprise from IBM Corp for $45 million.

In a statement, Uniphase said it will take a charge in the third quarter ending March 31, for acquired in-process R&D in connection with the acquisition. With the one time charge, the company said it expects to record a net loss for the quarter.

Uniphase said the business will operate as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Uniphase, Uniphase Laser Enterprise AG, based in Zurich, Switzerland and continue to market its lasers to leading telecommunications companies worldwide as well as supplying lasers to the Uniphase Telecommunications Products subsidiary.

Uniphase is an optoelectronics company that designs, develops, manufactures and markets laser subsystems, laser-based semiconductor wafer defect examination and analysis equipment and fiber optic telecommunications equipment products.
